role: CI gate: every CoreMotion handler closure passed to start*/query* APIs must be queue-delivered (`to:` on queue APIs) or start with `@Sendable`, preventing main-actor isolation SIGTRAPs on CoreMotion threads.
toplevel: cd to repo root. Roots = args or Emuqu and 'EmuquWatch Watch App'; exit 2 if no Swift file found. Python strips // comments (string-aware), finds `.startRelativeAltitudeUpdates(` etc. and `.startUpdates(`/`.queryPedometerData(`; looks in a 400-char window for the first `{`; no `{` -> skipped; queue APIs with `to:` -> ok; body starting `@Sendable` -> ok; else violation (exit 1). Wired: ci.yml (manual only) and Makefile coremotion-isolation-guard; NOT run by gates.yml on push.

flags.text: Not executed by the push workflow gates.yml (its make target list omits coremotion-isolation-guard); it only runs in manual ci.yml or local `make ci`, although it guards a crash that ended a user's walk. check_gates_wired.sh only inspects ci.yml so it does not notice.

The trailing-closure test uses the first `{` within 400 characters of the call. A handler passed by name with no `{` in that window is skipped; with a later unrelated `{` in the window, that brace's body is tested instead of the handler. strip_comments blanks only // comments, so a call written inside a /* */ block is reported. CMPedometer.startEventUpdates is not in the API list.
